# Press Releases


# Gaia Sets Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call for Monday, November 2, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. ET


[Download as PDF](https://content.equisolve.net/_03de463df639495ea8fe46f6c4d448d9/gaia/news/2026-10-26_Gaia_Sets_Third_Quarter_2026_Conference_Call_for_396.pdf) October 26, 2026 4:30pm EDT


BOULDER, Colo., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Gaia, Inc](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3HX2TyzR9NpapjeVoArLJ6OKmXi4RdpBOtOeQy-_oN_bV1wTxGG2KiZcaMRzpoRovfufKbe19QK063s5tBz4vg==) . (NASDAQ: GAIA), a conscious media and community company, will conduct a conference call on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. Eastern time (2:30 p.m. Mountain time) to discuss its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company will report its financial results in a press release prior to the call.


Gaia management will host the conference call, followed by a question and answer period.


Date: Monday, November 2, 2026
Time: 4:30 p.m. Eastern time (2:30 p.m. Mountain time)
Toll-free dial-in number: 1-877-269-7751
International dial-in number: 1-201-389-0908
Conference ID: 13763050


Please call the conference telephone number 5-10 minutes prior to the start time. An operator will register your name and organization. If you have any difficulty connecting with the conference call, please contact Gateway Group at 949-574-3860.


The conference call will be broadcast live and available for replay[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yky5CQ3uj_GSol4VQZV9ufqcUIGuNKtOZBNeScpgIs8InRTTrjXBOWBtozWLo8eJOrF3U9j-hemnHivcA_xtp4A1jHKcj7GGi2gWpccr61yPV72qG59asIT5aRaI83wztdRPq5FH3kU9Sq89UJCM-kXzfKSNILTwIuBju2IJ_1R8sF7grel4L62IB66aIBb9zqe6ENSTjhL1AJFHs7_XXWzWX80qzcJ-J97Oa1SDvheuj8kF51kg7WpJ8ryvonz1O-K0GQfKaGwZ4UuIKbwE6E9EUpIEeH6hknPyS0FYTqW4dk4iLEvFeHO0TMv1SL3ZIwn7_CQpSPQ1ziL8hG17vfvR2_KTx_6FQluAzk-T0iEXCoDTC-nq4AILMp2UvPTM) and via[ir.gaia.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=xg_JcrkLZS1j8vbzzNLW_vfTu-_pPtqFqvSu769in7HBbfHRqJ3C9q3ArTiORAvMXqe1vPTenBR3adm-BPGWUA==) .


A telephonic replay of the conference call will be available after 7:30 p.m. Eastern time on the same day through November 16, 2026.


Toll-free replay number: 1-844-512-2921
International replay number: 1-412-317-6671
Replay ID: 13763050


**About Gaia**


Gaia is a member-supported global video streaming service and community that produces and curates conscious media through four primary channels—Seeking Truth, Transformation, Alternative Healing and Yoga—in four languages (English, Spanish, French and German) to its members in 185 countries. Gaia’s library includes over 10,000 titles, over 90% of which is exclusive to Gaia, and approximately 75% of viewership is generated by content produced or owned by Gaia. Gaia is available on Apple TV, iOS, Android, Roku, Chromecast, and sold through Amazon Prime Video and Comcast Xfinity. For more information about Gaia, visit[www.gaia.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DyBEzmDMQiEVN5oWzrVj2bFScm4EbwvrdQogmHByIKB3i1o8R0Z_0LFoDvFgxcK2ghN6D6vrMs2Q_-rqhpDfKM28FQwElDS8tk_kGsc8tWdRwLaerlVtvH3E49w703qJ2b3XYOnYs-XpKk0q7RrMoaCclCt_XbJpMJGE458zPI1M8WwuRCESqQV6N50FmQ8phWnsXByGyCPCcF5DdPGDc3luVBmN-eaDAzPA-byT--g=) .
